### [component] Vortex  [id: 2052]
by xubohuah
“Vortex —A mathematical art generator in polar coordinates.”

Parameters:

t - time

r - radius (0 ~ 1)

th - angle θ

x, y - cartesian coordinates (-1 ~ 1)

noise() - random noise function

exp() - exponential function

hypot() - hypotenuse function

Features:

• Click to change pattern

• Edit expression directly

• Sharable via URL

• Press Space to toggle resolution

Math functions available:

sin, cos, tan, abs, sqrt, exp

hypot, atan2, max, min, round

ceil, floor, random

inspired by @antfu & @aemkei
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_2vl1Dn19f2uJMuYVfUEcAh5qqyv/vortex/default/preview.1747134779590.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/xubohuah/vortex?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 2052 })

Metadata is free. get_component (the code) is the PAID step - on the free tier it uses your daily retrieval quota (see get_usage).
